text:
deploy-bot: [deploy] kickoff: staged rollout canary-serve v2.4.0 -> 0%→30% (eu-west-1). change window: 2025-03-12 22:00-23:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.4.0

alice: seeing spike in 502s for svc-model-proxy across canaries. 5m error rate up from 0.8% -> 6.4%. sample log:
```
[2025-03-12T22:02:41Z] svc-model-proxy ERROR 502 upstream resp code=null trace_id=abc123
```

ben: oncall — looking. tailing proxy logs, checking node health. pinging @rachel infra

rachel: infra: euw-gpu-5 nodename shows OOM kills and kubelet restart at 22:01. suspect kubelet flag change in new image. scaling down that nodepool for now.

sam: ml-eng: +1 to pin traffic in eu-west while we triage. propose pin -> v2.3.9. command: `/deploy pin svc-model --version=2.3.9 --region=eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: [deploy] Hold requested. Rolling hold applied at 10% for canary-serve v2.4.0 in eu-west-1 (was 30%). To resume run `/deploy resume 1754501234` or react :white_check_mark: in-thread.

tina: release: I pushed a quick changelog note and opened PR https://redwood.internal/prs/4567 to mark partial hold/pin. If not resolved by 23:00 UTC we escalate to rollback. tagging @ben @sam

ben: monitoring dashboards. if 502s don't trend down in 15m we'll do a global rollback to 2.3.9. + I'll coordinate with ops to revert kubelet flag too.

alice: pushing hotfix branch to revert kv-cache config that might be triggering backpressure. link: https://redwood.internal/branches/kvfix-175450

sam: thanks — once infra stabilizes i'll sign off. for now eu-west pinned to 2.3.9, other regions continue staged rollout as scheduled.
